items.title: Billy McBride and Mary McBride ("Mack and Mack") Interview, 1959-07-01
items.q: And the trumpets we had from time to time was Joe Oliver, Tom McCary, Ernest Punch Miller, Sidney Parris, Junior, he's called Gabriel, Louis Armstrong.

ctx.x: You appeared at the Royal Garden too?

Yes, over on Carys Grove. She did. See, I at that time, this was a little later, say a couple of years, we went back down south and come back to Chicago, worked our way down and back again. We played the Grand Theater which was owned by Mr. Miller, the man that owned these monograms. He sent her to the Royal Garden.

Well, I was here for my little girl to be born, you know. She was four weeks old, that's when I went. Before I went back, I went down in Texas to take her down there for Mac to see her. But that's when I worked at the Lincoln, at the Royal Garden.
